description: Support exploratory data analysis and build dashboards for business teams. Candidates should know Python, pandas, SQL, statistics, and Git. Experience presenting findings clearly is preferred.
Clean healthcare operations data; create Excel and Power BI reports; and communicate trends to stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL, data visualization, and basic statistics is required.
Prototype machine learning models using Python and scikit-learn. Work includes feature engineering, model evaluation, Jupyter notebooks, and collaboration with software engineers.
Build Tableau dashboards and write SQL queries to track sales performance. Strong Excel skills, attention to detail, and experience explaining metrics are valued.
Help develop ETL pipelines using Python and SQL. Learn cloud data workflows, data quality testing, Git, and dimensional modeling while working with the analytics team.
Analyze user behavior and product experiments with SQL, Python, and A/B testing. Create clear visualizations and summarize recommendations for product managers.
Prepare research datasets and perform statistical analysis in R or Python. Experience with Excel, regression, data documentation, and written communication is helpful.
Measure campaign performance using Excel, SQL, and Google Analytics. Build recurring dashboards and present insights to marketing partners. Tableau or Power BI experience is a plus.
Clean shipment data, automate weekly reports with Python, and analyze operational trends using SQL and Excel. Candidates should be organized and comfortable collaborating across teams.
Assist with NLP prototypes in Python using PyTorch and transformer libraries. Responsibilities include preparing training data, evaluating models, and documenting experiments with Git.
Use Python, SQL, and Excel to analyze financial datasets and automate reporting. Knowledge of probability, statistics, Plotly, and careful data validation is preferred.
Support workforce reporting with Excel and Power BI. Clean survey data, calculate descriptive statistics, and communicate sensitive results clearly and responsibly.
Create interactive dashboards with Tableau or Plotly and translate complex energy data into accessible stories. Python, SQL, design awareness, and presentation skills are useful.
Explore customer datasets in Jupyter using Python, pandas, NumPy, and matplotlib. Apply clustering or regression methods and share reproducible findings through GitHub.
Help query cloud data warehouses and monitor data quality. Preferred skills include SQL, Python, AWS, ETL concepts, Git, and collaborative problem solving.
